commit.messageHeadline: fix(ui): publish initial model catalog on connect
fix(ui): declare catalog snapshot client scope
fix(ui): negotiate initial catalog for saved sessions
fix(ui): fence initial catalog publication against newer reads
test(ui): wire catalog bootstrap into gateway CI
fix(ui): type the initial catalog read scope
fix(ui): preserve catalog snapshots through reconnect
fix(ui): import gateway snapshot from its contract
fix(gateway): keep catalog bootstrap within CI budgets
fix(gateway): check catalog capability types without intersection
